# Cannot edit a product when the experimental Catalog price rules feature is enabled

When the experimental **Catalog price rules** feature is enabled, it is no longer possible to open a product edit page.

The following exception is thrown:

```text
Parameter "catalogPriceRuleId" for route "admin_catalog_price_rules_edit" must match "\d+" ("catalog_price_rule_id" given) to generate a corresponding URL.
```

The issue occurs **only when the experimental Catalog price rules feature is enabled**.

When the feature is disabled, product edit pages can be opened normally.


Related issue: https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/41118

## Étapes
1. Go to **Advanced Parameters > New & Experimental Features**.
2. Enable the experimental **Catalog price rules** feature.
3. Go to **Catalog > Products**.
4. Open any product for editing.
5. See the exception.

To confirm that the issue is related to the feature:

1. Disable the experimental **Catalog price rules** feature.
2. Open the same product again.
3. Check that the product edit page opens correctly.
